algorithm.scene_allocation: Hamilton largest remainder with exact integer arithmetic; ties by scene name ascending
algorithm.length: Sum of 3D Euclidean distances between consecutive trajectory_raw_detailed.position entries, in meters
algorithm.strata: Per scene sort by (route_length_m, uuid); split into three contiguous groups, extra entries assigned short then medium then long
algorithm.stratum_allocation: Hamilton largest remainder; ties short, medium, long
algorithm.sampling: Python random.Random(20261117), one shared generator; scenes sorted ascending, strata short/medium/long; random.sample without replacement from length/UUID-sorted groups
algorithm.index_rows: All original rows for selected json paths, in original order; original values unchanged
